Messages.Author: ma...@tpa.cent.com
Messages.Body:
I've seen mail-order places selling boxes of boosters for $55.00. Your
cards are worth about $0.08/lbs. (current price for recycling paper,
here anyway)

I still see people selling cards, and I've purchased some. A few stores
are still unloading what they have. I've priced them between $60 - $100.

My group will play with mix decks if anybody buys any of the new cards.
Right now we're looking for the expansion but not any V:TES starters or
boosters.

Eric
